doc.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024

title: Bob Jacobson's article about her
summary: Rowe and Sherman discuss Bob Jacobson's article in the Woonsocket publication.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: I don’t remember but the reason — I have to give you my in, in that a fellow named Bob Jacobson wrote an article about you.
Remember that? It was some years ago.
Oh I remembered. And he mentioned “Once in a While?”
Yes he did. He also mentioned a couple of other tunes that you sang before, as you said, before you could really talk. So I’ll send you a link to the article. You should read about yourself.
I’m sure he sent it to me. Is he a fan of yours?
Well he is helping out with these interviews. He lives in — he does some proofreading for us, and very knowledgeable.
